name: Abdominals
description: Core muscle group primarily composed of the rectus abdominis, responsible for flexing the spine and stabilizing the pelvis.

name: Ankle Stabilizers
description: Group of muscles and tendons (such as the peroneals and tibialis posterior) that maintain lateral and medial ankle stability.

name: Ankles
description: Joint and muscular region connecting the leg to the foot, enabling dorsiflexion, plantarflexion, and weight transfer.

name: Back
description: Comprehensive posterior muscle complex extending from the pelvis to the neck, responsible for pulling movements and spinal extension.

name: Biceps
description: Two-headed muscle on the front of the upper arm responsible for elbow flexion and forearm supination.

name: Brachialis
description: Muscle situated beneath the biceps brachii that acts as the primary and strongest flexor of the elbow joint.

name: Calves
description: Posterior lower leg muscles (gastrocnemius and soleus) that perform plantarflexion to lift the heel when walking, running, or jumping.

name: Chest
description: Pectoral muscle group (pectoralis major and minor) responsible for arm adduction, medial rotation, and pushing movements.

name: Core
description: Central neuromuscular unit (abs, lower back, diaphragm, pelvic floor) that transfers force and stabilizes the trunk.

name: Deltoids
description: Three-headed shoulder muscle (anterior, lateral, posterior) responsible for lifting and rotating the arm in all planes.

name: Feet
description: Intrinsic muscular and fascial structure of the foot that supports the plantar arch and absorbs ground impact.

name: Forearms
description: Muscle group in the lower arm controlling wrist movement, finger flexion/extension, and forearm rotation.

name: Glutes
description: Muscles of the buttocks (gluteus maximus, medius, and minimus) essential for hip extension, abduction, and pelvis stability.

name: Grip Muscles
description: Forearm and hand intrinsic muscles responsible for hand strength, crushing grip, and holding objects.

name: Groin
description: Junction area between the abdomen and thigh, primarily housing the hip adductor muscle group.

name: Hamstrings
description: Posterior thigh muscles (biceps femoris, semitendinosus, semimembranosus) responsible for knee flexion and hip extension.

name: Hands
description: Intrinsic hand musculature providing fine motor control, dexterity, and pinching ability.

name: Hip Flexors
description: Group of muscles (including the iliopsoas and rectus femoris) that lift the knee toward the torso.

name: Inner Thighs
description: Adductor muscles on the inside of the thigh that pull the leg inward toward the body's midline.

name: Latissimus Dorsi
description: Large flat muscle on the back responsible for arm extension, adduction, and internal rotation.

name: Lats
description: Common shorthand for latissimus dorsi; key muscle engaged in pulling movements like pull-ups and rows.

name: Lower Abs
description: Inferior portion of the rectus abdominis active in leg-raising movements and posterior pelvic tilt.

name: Lower Back
description: Lumbar region muscles (such as the erector spinae) dedicated to extending the spine and maintaining upright posture.

name: Obliques
description: Abdominal muscles located on the sides of the torso (internal and external) responsible for trunk rotation and lateral flexion.

name: Quadriceps
description: Four-headed muscle group on the front of the thigh primarily responsible for extending the knee joint.

name: Rear Deltoids
description: Posterior head of the shoulder muscle responsible for horizontal abduction and external rotation of the arm.

name: Rhomboids
description: Upper back muscles located between the shoulder blades that retract and stabilize the scapulae.

name: Rotator Cuff
description: Set of four muscles and tendons stabilizing the humeral head inside the shoulder socket during arm rotation.

name: Shins
description: Anterior lower leg muscles, primarily the tibialis anterior, responsible for dorsiflexing the foot.

name: Shoulders
description: Complex muscular structure surrounding the glenohumeral joint enabling full multi-planar arm movement.

name: Soleus
description: Deep lower leg muscle beneath the gastrocnemius that performs plantarflexion, especially when the knee is bent.

name: Sternocleidomastoid
description: Major neck muscle responsible for rotating, tilting, and flexing the head.

name: Trapezius
description: Large triangular back muscle that controls scapular elevation, depression, retraction, and neck movement.

name: Traps
description: Common shorthand for the trapezius muscle, heavily involved in shrugging and upper back support.

name: Triceps
description: Three-headed muscle on the back of the upper arm responsible for extending the elbow joint.

name: Upper Back
description: Region consisting of the trapezius, rhomboids, and rear deltoids that supports upper body posture and pulling mechanics.

name: Upper Chest
description: Clavicular head of the pectoralis major, activated heavily in inclined pushing movements.

name: Wrist Extensors
description: Posterior forearm muscles that bend the wrist backward (dorsiflexion).

name: Wrist Flexors
description: Anterior forearm muscles responsible for bending the wrist forward toward the inner arm.

name: Wrists
description: Articular and tendon-dense zone allowing multidirectional hand positioning and force transmission.
